# Results (generated by scripts/make_results_table.py)

MARS-style protocol, not the official MARS lists: 100-identity test subset (seed 255, 50 test identities plus distractors), camera-1 tracklet queries (n=145), single seed. Clustering is scored at frame level with thresholds tuned on a held-out identity half. Numbers are not comparable to published MARS scores.
